parameters.content:
PDF_DOWNLOAD

Standalone helper workflow that turns a generated question-paper filename into an actual PDF download. Called from the links on 01_EXAM_CONTROLLER's Form Ending completion page, of the form:
https://<N8N_PUBLIC_URL>/webhook/question-paper-download?file=Question_Paper_Set_A.pdf

SECURITY: 'Validate Allowed Filename' only accepts filenames matching Question_Paper_Set_<Letter>.pdf and rejects anything containing '..' or a path separator. The file path is always BASE_DIR + <validated filename> - the raw query parameter is never used to build a path directly. Update ALLOWED_FILENAME_PATTERN and BASE_DIR inside that node if 03_DOCUMENT_GENERATOR's output location/naming changes.

SETUP: no authentication is configured (demo/internal use). Activate this workflow so its production webhook URL is live, and make sure BASE_DIR matches the directory 03_DOCUMENT_GENERATOR actually writes PDFs to on this instance.
